name: Sd.Kfz. 251 half-track
about: Made by tools/battle-models (carrier). Metres; x forward, y right, z up. A battle model: `part` says which part each point belongs to; `parts` are the parts (parent, pivot, axis of turning, way of sliding); `sockets` are named places for flash, smoke, fire and wake; `clips` move the parts. Turns: +t degrees about an axis carries p to p cos t + (axis x p) sin t + axis (axis . p)(1 - cos t), about the part's pivot. Paints: 0 upper, 1 upper2, 2 shade, 3 track, 4 rubber, 5 steel, 6 bright, 7 wood, 8 canvas, 9 glass, 10 black, 11 rust, 12 lamp, 13 white, 14 red, 15 yellow, 16 blue, 17 leather, 18 torn, 19 rope, 20 cloth, 21 skin, 22 brass, 23 box.grey `mid`: the middle mesh, for about 40 to 140 m (~15,000 triangles): the near mesh thinned, small pieces gone, the far mesh's track band in place of the links, alike parts (road wheels) carrying the same mesh; its `part` numbers count the parts without the track links, as `far`'s do.

tracks.left.about: the left track runs on by one link (141 mm): loop it at (that side's speed in m/s) / stride * long; backward to go astern

tracks.right.about: the right track runs on by one link (141 mm): loop it at (that side's speed in m/s) / stride * long; backward to go astern

start.about: the engine is started: she shudders, a puff from the exhaust

drive.about: under way: the body's own motion on its springs (the game rolls and steers the wheels, runs the tracks and moves her)

move_off.about: she moves off: the nose lifts as she takes up the drive, and settles

stop.about: she brakes: start it as the brakes go on. The nose dips and stays down while she slows; she is at rest `rest` seconds in (play it faster or slower to fit), and the nose comes back up, a little over, and settles

knocked_out.about: knocked out: struck at 0.0, she sinks on a burst tyre, smoke, then fire at the engine; holds its last pose (follow with `burn`)

burn.about: burning: fire at the engine and in the body, black smoke (loop after knocked_out)

dismount.about: the way down is thrown open for the men (the game sets them down from the rider sockets); play it backward to close up

mg_burst.about: a burst from her machine gun: ten rounds

steer.what: the game steers the front wheels inside their lock: + to the right

mg.what: trained by the game inside its limits: + to the right

swaps.how: paint: put the chosen coat's colours in place of the paints of the same names.

desert42.what: light brown, the desert coat of 1942

by_ground.how: by_ground: on a field of this ground (the field's look: desert) the rows here are read before by_month, as by_month is read (from and to both counted in; a row with neither holds every month), and pick the coat; a month no row holds falls back to by_month. `under` is the colour that shows where the coat is worn through (the pictures' chips; the game's own wear may use it).

running.how: turn each wheel by (distance run on its side) / radius, in radians; play tracks.left and tracks.right at (speed of that side) / stride * long
